Verses.VerseAr: وَالطُّوۡرِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By the (Mountain) at-Tur,

Verses.VerseAr: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسۡطُوۡرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the Book inscribed,

Verses.VerseAr: فِىۡ رَقٍّ مَّنۡشُوۡرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Which is) on an Unfolded Scroll,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡبَيۡتِ الۡمَعۡمُوۡرِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the House populated (by the angels i.e. Ka‘ba in heaven),

Verses.VerseAr: وَالسَّقۡفِ الۡمَرۡفُوۡعِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the Lofty Roof (i.e. High Heaven or the Most Exalted Throne),

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡبَحۡرِ الۡمَسۡجُوۡرِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by the swelling sea!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لوَاقِعٌ ۙ
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the torment of your Lord will certainly take place.

Verses.VerseAr: مَّا لَهٗ مِنۡ دَافِعٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No one can avert it.

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ تَمُوۡرُ السَّمَآءُ مَوۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when the heaven will shake with a terrible tremor,

Verses.VerseAr: وَّتَسِيۡرُ الۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the mountains (leaving their locations) will fly fast (like clouds) and scatter (like dust particles),

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لِّـلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So on that Day woe to those who belie,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِىۡ خَوۡضٍ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who are playing a game of negligence, rapt in falsehood (absurdity).

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّوۡنَ اِلٰى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when they will be forcefully pushed towards the Fire of Hell,

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘This is the Fire of Hell you used to belie.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَسِحۡرٌ هٰذَاۤ اَمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So is it magic or do you not see?

Verses.VerseAr: اِصۡلَوۡهَا فَاصۡبِرُوۡۤا اَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُوۡا‌ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Enter it. Then it is all the same for you whether you observe patience or you do not observe patience. You will be paid only for those deeds which you used to do.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيۡمٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the Godfearing people will be in the Gardens and Bliss.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاكِهِيۡنَ بِمَاۤ اٰتٰٮهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ‌ۚ وَوَقٰٮهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will be delighted at and rejoicing in the (bestowals) their Lord will have blessed them with. And their Lord will keep them safe from the punishment of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِٓيْئًا ۢ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Relish food and drink as reward of the (pious) deeds which you used to do.’

Verses.VerseAr: مُتَّكِــِٕيۡنَ عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مَّصۡفُوۡفَةٍ‌ۚ وَّزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will be reclining (sitting) on couches arranged in rows and We will marry them to maidens with fair colour (and) fascinating eyes.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمۡ بِاِيۡمَانٍ اَلۡحَـقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَاۤ اَلَـتۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ كُلُّ امۡرِیءٍۢ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who believe and their children follow them in faith, We shall unite their children also with them (in the ranks of Paradise even if their actions would not fall in that grade. It would be in the honour of their pious fathers). And We will also not reduce anyway the reward of the actions of their (pious fathers. Besides this,) everyone will be held in (reward and punishment of) his own works.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمۡدَدۡنٰهُمۡ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحۡمٍ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We will keep giving them fruits and meat more and more as they desire.

Verses.VerseAr: يَتَنَازَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا لَّا لَغۡوٌ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَاۡثِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There, they will take the cups (of holy drink) by grabbing. This (holy drink of Paradise) will be free of foolish talk and sinful acts.

Words.MeaningEn: They will pass to one another

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٌ لَّهُمۡ كَاَنَّهُمۡ لُـؤۡلُـؤٌ مَّكۡنُوۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (the serving) youths will go round them, as if they were pearls kept hidden in covers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ يَّتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they will turn to one another enquiring well-being.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا كُـنَّا قَبۡلُ فِىۡۤ اَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘Surely before this we used to live in fear (of Allah’s torment) in our homes.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقٰٮنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Allah has been Gracious to favour us and has saved us from the punishment of the Fire of Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا كُـنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوۡهُ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡبَرُّ الرَّحِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed we used to worship Him alone beforehand. Surely He is Most Gracious, Ever-Merciful.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجۡنُوۡنٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, (O Esteemed Beloved,) continue to admonish (them). By the grace and blessing of your Lord you are neither a soothsayer (i.e. the one who gives news through the jinn) nor a madman.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيۡبَ الۡمَنُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do the disbelievers say: ‘(He is) a poet for whom we look forward to some temporal disasters’?

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُوۡا فَاِنِّىۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُتَرَبِّصِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Wait on, I am also waiting together with you (for your destruction).’

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ تَاۡمُرُهُمۡ اَحۡلَامُهُمۡ بِهٰذَآ‌ اَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do their mental faculties suggest them this (foolishness) or are they rioters and rebels?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗ‌ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or do they say: ‘He (the Messenger) has invented it (the Qur’an) himself’? (No indeed;) rather they simply do not believe (in the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: فَلۡيَاۡتُوۡا بِحَدِيۡثٍ مِّثۡلِهٖۤ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا صٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So let them produce a treatise like this (Qur’an) if they are truthful.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ خُلِقُوۡا مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَىۡءٍ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡخَـالِقُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they been created by nothing or are they themselves the creators?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ‌ۚ بَل لَّا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or did they create the heavens and the earth themselves? (No indeed;) in fact they do not have any faith (in the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآٮِٕنُ رَبِّكَ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or do they own the treasures of your Lord? Or are they guards and watchmen over them?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٌ يَّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ‌ ۚ فَلۡيَاۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or do they have any ladder (by which they ascend) and listen stealthily (to the heaven)? So let the listener among them bring the clear proof.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ لَـهُ الۡبَنٰتُ وَلَـكُمُ الۡبَنُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Are there daughters for Him (the Lord) and sons for you?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔـلُهُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do you ask them for wages that they are weighed down with debt?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمُ الۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they have (the knowledge of) the unseen that they write down?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ كَيۡدًا‌ؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا هُمُ الۡمَكِيۡدُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they seek to deceive (you) by trick? Those who disbelieve are being caught in their own trap.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اِلٰهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they have any god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah, above all what they set up as a partner (with Allah).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا كِسۡفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوۡلُوۡا سَحَابٌ مَّرۡكُوۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if they see a fragment of the sky falling (on them, even then) they will say: ‘It is a layered (thick) cloud.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِىۡ فِيۡهِ يُصۡعَقُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So leave them (in their plight) till they meet that Day of theirs when they will be destroyed,

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِىۡ عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيْئًا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when their plots will be of no use for them, nor will they be helped.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا عَذَابًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And for those who are committed to doing wrong, there is a torment for them besides this torment as well but most of them do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا‌ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِيۡنَ تَقُوۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Esteemed Beloved, do not grieve over what they say). Wait patiently for the Command of your Lord. Surely you are (at all times) before Our eyes. And glorify your Lord with His praise whenever you stand forth.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَاِدۡبَارَ النُّجُوۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And also glorify Him during the hours of the night and (in later part of it) when the stars fade out.
